name: When should I hire a remodeling contractor instead of a closet organizer company for a pantry?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a remodeling contractor instead of a closet organizer company for a pantry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a licensed remodeling contractor is necessary when a pantry project requires altering partition walls, hanging new drywall, installing dedicated doors, or adding electrical circuits. A full-service contractor manages structural framing, drywall taping, trim carpentry, and integration with adjacent kitchen surfaces. Handyman services or closet kit assemblers typically handle pre-manufactured wire racks within an existing, fully finished opening. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms handles both structural additions and custom kitchen casework, ensuring the new pantry matches the architectural style of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a remodeling contractor when your project involves framing walls, hanging drywall, installing electrical outlets, or custom cabinetry that matches your kitchen.
